announcements.id: Unique identifier of the announcement record.
announcements.created_by_user_id: Staff account that wrote the announcement; empty if that account was later deleted.
announcements.title: Headline of the announcement.
announcements.audience: Role the announcement is addressed to; empty means it is shown to every role.
announcements.published_at: Date and time the announcement was published.
announcements.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
announcements.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
audit_logs.id: Unique identifier of the audit log entry record.
audit_logs.user_id: Account that performed the recorded action; empty for system actions.
audit_logs.action: Short code naming the action taken, such as user.approved or backup.created.
audit_logs.description: Human-readable summary of what was done.
audit_logs.ip_address: Network address the action was made from.
audit_logs.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
audit_logs.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
clearance_records.id: Unique identifier of the clearance record.
clearance_records.graduate_profile_id: Graduate whose clearance this record tracks.
clearance_records.office: Office giving clearance: library, accounting, registrar, department, student affairs, or alumni office.
clearance_records.status: Clearance state for that office: pending or cleared.
clearance_records.cleared_by_user_id: Staff account that marked the graduate as cleared.
clearance_records.cleared_at: Date and time clearance was granted.
clearance_records.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
clearance_records.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
community_comments.id: Unique identifier of the community comment record.
community_comments.community_post_id: Community post the comment replies to.
community_comments.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
community_comments.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
community_posts.id: Unique identifier of the community post record.
community_posts.body: Text of the post shared with the alumni community.
community_posts.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
community_posts.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
companies.id: Unique identifier of the company record.
companies.owner_user_id: Industry partner account that manages the company; each account manages at most one company.
companies.name: Registered name of the company.
companies.location: City or address of the company.
companies.logo_path: Storage location of the uploaded company logo.
companies.is_verified: Whether an administrator has verified the company.
companies.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
companies.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
conversation_participants.id: Unique identifier of the conversation participant record.
conversation_participants.conversation_i: Conversation the account takes part in.
conversation_participants.user_id: Account taking part in the conversation.
conversation_participants.last_read_at: When the participant last opened the conversation, used to count unread messages.
conversation_participants.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
conversation_participants.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
conversations.id: Unique identifier of the conversation record.
conversations.subject: Optional subject line of the conversation.
conversations.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
conversations.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
departments.id: Unique identifier of the college or program record.
departments.name: Full name of the college or program, such as College of Computer Studies.
departments.code: Short unique code, such as CCS or BSIT.
departments.type: Whether the record is a college or a program.
departments.parent_id: College a program belongs to; empty for a college.
departments.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
departments.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
education_records.id: Unique identifier of the education record.
education_records.graduate_profile_id: Graduate the education record belongs to.
education_records.end_year: Year the studies ended or are expected to end.
education_records.honors: Academic honors received, such as cum laude.
education_records.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
education_records.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
employer_feedbacks.id: Unique identifier of the employer feedback record.
employer_feedbacks.job_application_id: Application the feedback concerns, if it came from one.
employer_feedbacks.submitted_by_user_id: Industry partner account that submitted the feedback.
employer_feedbacks.competency_ratings: Ratings for each competency, stored as structured data.
employer_feedbacks.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
employer_feedbacks.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
employment_records.id: Unique identifier of the employment record.
employment_records.graduate_profile_id: Graduate the employment record belongs to.
employment_records.employment_type: Kind of employment: full-time, part-time, contract, internship, or freelance.
employment_records.is_current: Whether this is the graduate’s current job.
employment_records.end_date: Date the job ended; empty for a current job.
employment_records.monthly_salary_range: Monthly salary bracket reported by the graduate.
employment_records.is_related_to_course: Whether the job is related to the graduate’s degree program, used in tracer reports.
employment_records.how_obtained: How the graduate found the job, such as a referral or job fair.
employment_records.description: Description of the role and responsibilities.
employment_records.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
employment_records.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
event_rsvps.id: Unique identifier of the event RSVP record.
event_rsvps.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
event_rsvps.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
events.id: Unique identifier of the event record.
events.created_by_user_id: Staff account that created the event; empty if that account was later deleted.
events.title: Name of the event.
events.type: Kind of event: career fair, workshop, networking, seminar, or other.
events.location: Venue or online link of the event.
events.starts_at: Date and time the event starts.
events.ends_at: Date and time the event ends.
events.capacity: Maximum number of attendees; empty means no limit.
events.status: Publication state: draft, published, or cancelled.
events.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
events.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
graduate_profiles.id: Unique identifier of the graduate profile record.
graduate_profiles.user_id: Account the profile belongs to; each account has at most one profile.
graduate_profiles.department_id: Program, or college if no program was chosen, the graduate belongs to.
graduate_profiles.program: Name of the degree program as shown on the profile.
graduate_profiles.expected_graduation_ye: Year a graduating student expects to graduate.
graduate_profiles.gender: Gender: male, female, other, or prefer not to say.
graduate_profiles.headline: One-line professional headline shown to employers.
graduate_profiles.current_employment_sta: Current status: employed, unemployed, self-employed, further study, or not seeking.
graduate_profiles.willing_to_relocate: Whether the graduate is willing to move for work.
graduate_profiles.profile_completion: Percentage of the profile filled in, from 0 to 100.
graduate_profiles.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
graduate_profiles.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
graduate_skill.id: Unique identifier of the graduate skill link record.
graduate_skill.source: How the skill was added; the system currently records every skill as added by the graduate (self).
graduate_skill.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
graduate_skill.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
job_applications.id: Unique identifier of the job application record.
job_applications.graduate_profile_id: Graduate who applied; a graduate applies to a posting only once.
job_applications.cover_letter: Cover letter written for the application.
job_applications.status: Stage of the application: submitted, under review, shortlisted, rejected, hired, or withdrawn.
job_applications.applied_at: Date and time the application was submitted.
job_applications.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
job_applications.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
job_match_results.id: Unique identifier of the job match result record.
job_match_results.graduate_profile_id: Graduate that was matched; one result per graduate per posting.
job_match_results.similarity: Similarity between the résumé and the posting, computed from their embeddings.
job_match_results.explanation: AI explanation of why the graduate fits or does not fit.
job_match_results.skill_gaps: Skills the posting asks for that the graduate lacks.
job_match_results.matched_skills: Skills the graduate has that the posting asks for.
job_match_results.recommendation: AI verdict on the match: strong, moderate, or weak.
job_match_results.scored_by: AI provider that produced the score, such as Groq or Gemini.
job_match_results.scored_at: Date and time the match was scored.
job_match_results.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
job_match_results.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
job_posting_skill.id: Unique identifier of the job posting skill link record.
job_posting_skill.job_posting_id: Job posting that requires the skill.
job_posting_skill.is_required: Whether the skill is required, as opposed to preferred.
job_posting_skill.weight: Relative importance of the skill, as set by the employer; stored but not currently used in matching.
job_posting_skill.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
job_posting_skill.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
job_postings.id: Unique identifier of the job posting record.
job_postings.posted_by_user_id: Industry partner account that posted the job.
job_postings.title: Job title.
job_postings.qualifications: Qualifications the employer is looking for.
job_postings.employment_type: Kind of employment: full-time, part-time, contract, internship, or freelance.
job_postings.is_remote: Whether the job can be done remotely.
job_postings.status: Publication state: draft, open to applicants, or closed.
job_postings.embedding_status: Progress of the AI embedding: pending, processing, done, or failed.
job_postings.embedded_at: Date and time the AI embedding was generated.
job_postings.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
job_postings.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
job_postings.embedding: AI vector representation of the posting (768 numbers), used to find matching résumés.
learning_resource_skill.id: Unique identifier of the learning resource skill link record.
learning_resource_skill.learning_resourc: Learning resource that teaches the skill.
learning_resource_skill.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
learning_resource_skill.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
learning_resources.id: Unique identifier of the learning resource record.
learning_resources.created_by_user_id: Staff account that added the resource; empty if that account was later deleted.
learning_resources.department_id: College or program the resource is meant for; empty means all.
learning_resources.title: Name of the resource.
learning_resources.type: Kind of resource: training, seminar, certification, course, article, or link.
learning_resources.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
learning_resources.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
match_feedback.id: Unique identifier of the match feedback record.
match_feedback.user_id: Account giving the feedback; one rating per account per match.
match_feedback.rating: Whether the match was helpful or not helpful.
match_feedback.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
match_feedback.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
messages.id: Unique identifier of the message record.
messages.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
messages.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
model_has_permissions.permission_id: Permission granted directly to an account.
model_has_permissions.model_type: Kind of record holding the permission; always a user account in this system.
model_has_roles.model_type: Kind of record holding the role; always a user account in this system.
notification_preferences.id: Unique identifier of the notification preference record.
notification_preferences.preference_key: Kind of notification, such as application updates.
notification_preferences.enabled: Whether the account receives that kind of notification.
notification_preferences.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
notification_preferences.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
notifications.notifiable_type: Kind of record notified; a user account in this system.
notifications.data: Content of the notification shown in the app.
notifications.read_at: Date and time the notification was read; empty while unread.
notifications.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
notifications.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
permissions.id: Unique identifier of the permission record.
permissions.name: Name of the permission, such as candidates.search.
permissions.guard_name: Sign-in system the permission applies to; always "web" here.
permissions.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
permissions.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
reports.id: Unique identifier of the generated report record.
reports.generated_by_user_id: Staff account that generated the report; empty if that account was later deleted.
reports.report_type: Kind of report: employability or program outcomes.
reports.parameters: Filters used to generate the report.
reports.file_path: Storage location of the exported report file.
reports.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
reports.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
resumes.id: Unique identifier of the résumé record.
resumes.mime_type: File format, such as PDF or Word.
resumes.extracted_text: Text read from the file, used for AI analysis and matching.
resumes.is_primary: Whether this is the résumé used by default for matching and applications.
resumes.embedding_status: Progress of the AI embedding: pending, processing, done, or failed.
resumes.embedded_at: Date and time the AI embedding was generated.
resumes.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
resumes.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
resumes.embedding: AI vector representation of the résumé (768 numbers), used to find matching jobs.
resumes.source: How the résumé was made: uploaded as a file or built with the Résumé Builder.
roles.id: Unique identifier of the role record.
roles.name: Name of the role, such as student or alumni_affairs.
roles.guard_name: Sign-in system the role applies to; always "web" here.
roles.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
roles.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
scholarship_recipients.id: Unique identifier of the scholarship recipient record.
scholarship_recipients.graduate_profile_: Student who received the scholarship; once per scholarship.
scholarship_recipients.awarded_at: Date and time the scholarship was awarded.
scholarship_recipients.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
scholarship_recipients.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
scholarships.id: Unique identifier of the scholarship program record.
scholarships.created_by_user_id: Staff account that added the program; empty if that account was later deleted.
scholarships.name: Name of the scholarship program.
scholarships.description: Details and eligibility of the program.
scholarships.budget_amount: Total budget of the program in pesos.
scholarships.status: State of the program: active, pending, or closed.
scholarships.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
scholarships.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
settings.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
settings.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
skill_aliases.id: Unique identifier of the skill alias record.
skill_aliases.alias: Alternative name for the skill, such as JS for JavaScript.
skill_aliases.alias_slug: Normalized form of the alias used for lookups.
skill_aliases.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
skill_aliases.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
skills.id: Unique identifier of the skill record.
skills.name: Name of the skill.
skills.slug: Normalized form of the name used for lookups.
skills.category: Skill group, such as Computing & IT or Nursing & Healthcare.
skills.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
skills.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
student_cases.id: Unique identifier of the student concern case record.
student_cases.reported_by_user_id: Account that reported the concern; empty if that account was later deleted.
student_cases.assigned_to_user_id: Student Affairs staff handling the case.
student_cases.category: Kind of concern: academic, financial, personal, disciplinary, or other.
student_cases.status: Progress of the case: open, in progress, resolved, or closed.
student_cases.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
student_cases.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
survey_answers.id: Unique identifier of the survey answer record.
survey_answers.survey_response_id: Response the answer is part of.
survey_answers.value: The answer given, stored as structured data so choice, rating and text answers fit one column.
survey_answers.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
survey_answers.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
survey_questions.id: Unique identifier of the survey question record.
survey_questions.order: Position of the question in the survey.
survey_questions.type: Answer format: text, long text, single choice, multiple choice, rating, yes/no, or number.
survey_questions.is_required: Whether the question must be answered.
survey_questions.maps_to: Profile field the answer updates, such as employment status or job title; empty if none.
survey_questions.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
survey_questions.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
survey_responses.id: Unique identifier of the survey response record.
survey_responses.survey_id: Survey being answered; one response per account per survey.
survey_responses.status: Whether the response is still in progress or has been submitted.
survey_responses.submitted_at: Date and time the response was submitted.
survey_responses.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
survey_responses.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
surveys.id: Unique identifier of the survey record.
surveys.created_by_user_id: Staff account that created the survey; empty if that account was later deleted.
surveys.title: Name of the survey.
surveys.description: Purpose and instructions of the survey.
surveys.type: Kind of survey: employability, tracer, career readiness, or custom.
surveys.target_role: Role the survey is sent to; empty means every graduate role.
surveys.target_graduation_year: Graduation year the survey is limited to; empty means all years.
surveys.status: Whether the survey is a draft, open for answers, or closed.
surveys.opens_at: Date and time the survey opens.
surveys.closes_at: Date and time the survey closes.
surveys.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
surveys.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
users.id: Unique identifier of the user account record.
users.first_name: First name of the account holder.
users.last_name: Last name of the account holder.
users.id_number: School-issued ID number; unique when given.
users.email: Email address used to sign in; unique per account.
users.email_verified_at: Date and time the email address was confirmed; empty until confirmed.
users.password: Password, stored only as a one-way hash, never as plain text.
users.status: Account state: active, pending admin approval, or suspended.
users.department_id: College a staff member or Department Head belongs to.
users.remember_token: Token that keeps the user signed in when "Remember me" is ticked.
users.created_at: Date and time the record was created.
users.updated_at: Date and time the record was last changed.
